entries.text: The locked `filelock` moves from 3.25.2 to 4.2.4 to clear CVE-2026-112940, CVE-2026-112913 and CVE-2026-112907, which are fixed only in 4.2.1 and later. `[tool.uv] override-dependencies = ["filelock>=4.2.1,<5"]` is required because every resolvable `snowflake-connector-python` declares `filelock<4` and every `snowflake-snowpark-python` caps the connector below 5. The other locked consumers already accept 4.x (`huggingface-hub>=3.10.0`, `torch` unbounded, `tox>=3.20.3`, `virtualenv<5,>=3.24.2`, `python-discovery>=3.15.4`). The only 4.0.0 breaking change in the filelock changelog is the `SoftReadWriteLock` on-disk protocol, which none of them use; the connector imports only `FileLock`, `Timeout` and `BaseFileLock`. The `uv.lock` hashes for 4.2.4 match PyPI (wheel 301241438c57, sdist c6d8663535e1). The wheel grows from 26,759 to 162,475 bytes and the sdist from 40,480 to 652,444 bytes because the package grew from 11 modules and 76,684 bytes of Python to 23 modules and 573,230 bytes (the soft and read-write lock implementations, `_api.py`, `asyncio.py`), and because the sdist has shipped `docs/` since 4.1.0. Remove the override once the connector and snowpark allow `filelock>=4`.
